user: How will I receive updates about a dispute?
answer:
A dispute generates a notification on every change in its status. The notification names the new status but not the internal reason for any decision. The statuses are:

- **Open:** the dispute has been filed.
- **Under review:** the case is being assessed.
- **Provisional credit:** money has been credited back to you while the case continues.
- **Resolved, upheld:** the dispute was accepted.
- **Resolved, declined:** the dispute was not accepted.

The knowledge base doesn't say which channel the notifications use (app, email, or SMS), so I can't confirm that.

You can withdraw a dispute while it is open or under review. A withdrawal is final, and you cannot dispute the same transaction again under the same reason code.

fragments.text:
Notifications
## Dispute updates
A dispute generates a notification on every state change. The notification
names the state, never the internal reason for a decision.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Dispute handling process
## Case states
A dispute moves through: open, under_review, provisional_credit,
resolved_upheld, resolved_declined. Only open and under_review cases can be
withdrawn by the customer.

Payment dispute rules
## Escalation on blocked disputes
When a dispute is blocked by a customer-level restriction, the case must be
escalated to a human agent.
